Components / Forms

Picker row

.dr-field--action · __label · __value · __chev · .dr-picker__list · .dr-picker__item · .dr-picker__label · .dr-sheet--picker · components/form.css · kit specimen

Anatomy

  1. 1.dr-field--actionThe row, a real <button> with aria-haspopup="dialog", aria-expanded and aria-controls naming its drawer. min-height 44, gap 10, flex-wrap: nowrap, so a long value takes the ellipsis instead of a second line.
  2. 2.dr-field__labelThe key, 15 --slate, in the group's 96px label column: 5.95:1 on the card, 6.62:1 in a plain list.
  3. 3.dr-field__valueThe chosen value, --ink 15/600: 14.37:1 on the card, 15.99:1 in a plain list. It reads from its left edge, level with a typed value.
  4. 4.dr-field__chevchevron.forward, 16px --slate, in a track of its own, flush with the trailing edge. Never a down arrow: the list arrives from elsewhere.

Variants and sizes

Inventory rows: Picker row; Input · select.

States

Light

Dark

Try it: hover, press, Tab. Follows the theme switch above.

The row and two of the options it opens, selected and not. From account-edit.

When to use

A picker row is a form row whose value is chosen, not typed. Where the list appears is a count: up to six options rise as a drawer from the bottom edge, and seven or more push a new screen in from the right. No list in the product reaches seven, so every picker is a drawer. Picker rows stand on 9 files: payment (4) and language (2) on account-edit; parcel size (3) on order-setup and order-setup-error; shoot, duration and what you get (3 each) on order-setup-aerial; issue type (3) on report-issue; mode (2) on account and operator-account; availability (3) on operator-listings and operator-listings-empty. The same .dr-picker__list also fills drawers that no picker row opens: Contact operator (3) on the nine tracking files, Contact client (2) on job-checklist and job-checklist-error, and Pickup address (3) on the four listings files.

The drawer keeps the modal contract. Everything behind it is inert, Tab cycles inside it, and it closes three ways: Esc, the scrim, and Cancel, which HIG · Action sheets asks for by name. Each returns focus to the row, which by then shows the new value. An option is a <button> when it sets a value and an <a> when it is a route, like the mode picker's options.

The label is the dictionary noun for what is being set, and the value is the option's own words, so the row reads as a sentence: Parcel size · Small, up to 2 kg.

Sources: DESIGN.md § The picker row — a form row whose value is chosen, not typed · inventory.md § 1.5 · voice.md P4

Rule and anti-rule

Do

order-setup's parcel size: three fixed answers, so the row opens a drawer and the value is never typed. It shares a plain list with the two typed addresses.

Don’t

A picker row for an open answer. A value the user has to write is a field. Two or three options that should all stay visible on the screen are radios, and a choice that leaves the screen is a choice card.
